test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the correct statement about Rajya Sabha.

options.text: It is called upper house of parliament and it never dissolves.
The President of India act as ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.
A member who is elected for a full term in Rajya Sabha serves for a period of four years.
It is the lower house of parliament and it dissolves every five years.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is called upper house of parliament and it never dissolves.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajya Sabha:**

 
 
• Rajya Sabha or the **‘Council of States’ is the second chamber of the Indian parliament, which traces its origin to the Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms, 1919.**
 
• **Rajya Sabha as the second chamber of the parliament intended to play certain roles as a permanent house.**
 
• **It never dissolves like Lok sabha. **
 
• It is **called upper house of parliament and it never dissolves.**
 
• One-third of its members r**etire every two years,** revisionary house **(reconsidering bills passed by the Lok Sabha), and offers a degree of continuity in the underlying policies of laws passed by parliament. .**
 
• Its member shall not be **less than 30 years of age.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Representing the Vulnerable Sections:**

 
 
• Women, religious, ethnic, and **linguistic minority groups are not adequately represented in the Lok Sabha (due to first past the post-election system).**
 
• **An indirect form of election (through propositional representation) to the Rajya Sabha, therefore, would give them a chance to get involved in the nation’s law-making process.**
 
• Thus, Rajya Sabha can make a place for people who may **not be able to win a popular mandate.**
 
 
 
• **Special Powers of Rajya Sabha:**
 
 
• The **Upper House also has some special powers, such as:**
 
• **Power to transfer a subject from the State List to Union List for a specified period (Article 249).**
 
• To create additional **All-India Services (Article 312).**
 
• To endorse Emergency under **Article 352 for a limited period when the Lok Sabha remains dissolved.**
